title: Montserrat and Priorat tours
text: We had an incredible experience in Montserrat, thanks to our local guides Carl and Peter. They are a fountain of information in their knowledge of the area and quite comical when not walking through such magnificent views and monuments.  The day was so enjoyable, we immediately booked the Priorat wine tour before leaving Tarragona on our short 6 day adventure. Saying goodbye the second day was like saying goodbye to family. We were a group of 6 and each give both Carl and Peter a 10 out of 10!
author: sandil544

title: The Montserrat Monastery: A visit not to be missed!
text: Personalized tour that is worth it! The monastery is a beautiful place! Friendly and professional guides! Thank you, Carl and Peter!
author: Passenger00050837868

title: Great tour of Montserrat
text: Our guides were Peter & Carl.  We thoroughly enjoyed them & their insights of Montserrat & Barcelona.  They were very knowledgeable & you could tell that they enjoyed what they were doing.  On the day of our tour it was raining, but Peter & Carl were prepared with umbrellas and modified the tour as needed to keep us dry.  Highly recommend them as your guide.
author: lesliewY6584DB

title: A Most Gratifying Excursion
text:
Carl and Peter were amazing guides! They worked as a team to meet our every need including separating the activities to fit physical limitations and abilities.  Every ticketed activity was timed perfectly to avoid the largest crowds. Both of them were fountains of knowledge regarding the monastery, the history of the basilica and the Black Virgin. They also had experience staying in the area, hiking and  experiencing nature.  This personal knowledge added to our understanding and appreciation of the park and its environs.

title: Fantastic!
text:
Our group included my wife and me along with my brother and his wife. My sister in law has mobility issues which I shared with brothers Pete and Carl. Montserrat is an amazing place even if you walk through it on your own. The architecture and the views from this mountain monastery are stunning. 

But what really made this tour unforgettable is how Pete and Carl brought everything to life! The information they shared and the enthusiasm with which they shared it was awe inspiring. title: Montserrat private tour with Carl & Peter
text: Carl & Peter were incredible tour guides for this fantastic Montserrat excursion. First class from pickup, transport, planning of tickets for events, great conversations and capturing the beauty of Montserrat within 5 hours round trip.

title: Best private tour to Montserrat!
text: This review is long overdue, but we cannot let one full year go by without giving our rave reviews for Carl and "Day Trips Barcelona."  Carl was very knowledgeable about the history of the Black Madonna, Montserrat Abbey and its surrounding mountain range. He was very attentive to all our needs, going with our somewhat slow-pace due to a painful foot/ankle that I twisted a few days before. He customized our private tour so that we can be able to see and do everything we wanted to at my slower pace, getting us very early to the basilica to touch the Black Madonna before the crowd and tour group
author: Ruby D

title: Amazing trip
